title: Resolution honoring NYC's role in the American Revolution
summary: This resolution commemorates New York City's political and military role in the founding of the United States 250 years ago, citing events such as 1765 Stamp Act protests, the 1776 reading of the Declaration of Independence at the Commons, and the city's time as the nation's first capital. It does not create any program or funding, but formally recognizes this history as part of the nation's 250th anniversary commemorations.
